observations: Most depended-on units (single points of failure): bun_core (108), bun_alloc (59), bun_collections (45), bun_sys (43), bun_ast (35).
1 units have no inbound edge, no binary and are never named elsewhere: unwired candidates for wiring into ay or deletion.
1 more units have no manifest or path edge but are named in other sources; their use is dynamic (FFI, generated code, docs) and is not counted dead.
136 of 223 Rust units are absorbed Bun crates (bun_*).
Units linking a data-store client (manifest dependency or Bun built-in API; read/write not measured): SQLite 12, S3 / R2 4, Valkey / Redis 2, Postgres 2.
Every ay External route resolves to a binary in the tree.
